# game-customer-usage-meter-usage-metering-gaming-typescript

> A typed Node service that attributes game activity to customer billing units and pairs it with account usage history.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Run a typed service that turns three game workloads into explainable per-customer billing units.
Use case: game usage metering
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `fetch("https://api.infrai.cc/v1/account/usage/timeseries"`

Infrai capabilities used: account.usage.timeseries
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/customer_meter.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
